name: Telekinetic Slam
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You telekinetically lift the target and quickly slam them into the ground. The target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). A Fortitude save halves this damage.
